name: Portal Attachment Paths

meta.description: Global inlet: carries chat attachments (id, name, type, size) plus the sandbox path each upload is staged at into body['portal_attached_files'], which is forwarded to the Portal pipeline; the pipeline turns them into per-file notes so the model reads the full file with its tools instead of answering from RAG excerpts.

content:
# Portal attachment paths — global inlet filter (seeded by scripts/openwebui_init.py).
# Open WebUI v0.12.5 pops body["files"] AFTER the inlet filters run (middleware.py
# process_chat_payload), then drops "metadata" before POSTing an OpenAI-compatible
# connection (routers/openai.py generate_chat_completion). The Portal pipeline
# therefore never learns an upload exists on disk. This inlet carries each
# attachment (id, name, type, size) plus its sandbox path into a top-level
# "portal_attached_files" key, which v0.12.5 forwards verbatim. The pipeline
# turns each item into one "[Attached file … path …]" note. Each id is resolved
# through OWUI's own record (Files.get_file_by_id — async in v0.12.5; OWUI awaits
# async inlet handlers, utils/filter.py run_filter_handler): the stored path's
# basename mounted under /workspace/uploads is the exact staged name, and
# filename/meta carry the authoritative name, content_type and size. The request
# item's own fields are only the fallback for a failed import or lookup. Stored
# uploads are <uuid>_<filename> under /app/backend/data/uploads (= /workspace
# /uploads in the code sandbox); very long filenames fall back to <uuid>.<ext>,
# so the id stays authoritative. Do NOT set file_handler: the RAG retrieval path
# must keep its files.
import os


class Filter:
    async def inlet(self, body: dict) -> dict:
        files = body.get("files")
        if not isinstance(files, list):
            return body
        carried = []
        seen = set()
        for item in files:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            fid = str(item.get("id") or "")
            if not fid or fid in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(fid)
            carried.append(_carried_item(await _stored_file(fid), fid, item))
        if carried:
            body["portal_attached_files"] = carried
        return body


async def _stored_file(fid: str):
    try:
        from open_webui.models.files import Files

        return await Files.get_file_by_id(fid)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _carried_item(record, fid: str, item: dict) -> dict:
    name = str(item.get("name") or "")
    meta = item.get("meta")
    size = item.get("size")
    if size is None and isinstance(meta, dict):
        size = meta.get("size")
    ftype = str(item.get("type") or "file")
    if record is not None:
        rmeta = record.meta if isinstance(record.meta, dict) else {}
        name = str(getattr(record, "filename", "") or rmeta.get("name") or name)
        if rmeta.get("size") is not None:
            size = rmeta.get("size")
        ftype = str(rmeta.get("content_type") or ftype)
    path = f"/workspace/uploads/{fid}_{name}" if name else f"/workspace/uploads/{fid}"
    stored = os.path.basename(str(getattr(record, "path", "") or "")) if record is not None else ""
    if stored:
        path = f"/workspace/uploads/{stored}"
    return {"id": fid, "name": name, "type": ftype, "size": size, "path": path}
